size.value: 3.5 x 4.5 cm (color or black-and-white photo accepted). Official Russian text: 'цветной, либо черно-белой фотографией размером 3,5 х 4,5 сантиметров'

cross_verification.note: size confirmed via two independent egov.kz pages (English: 'Issuance, restoration or extension...of visas for the right to leave/enter the Republic of Kazakhstan' service page pass597_mvd, referencing Annex 6 to the Rules; Russian: rk_visa_obtaining article) — both state 3.5×4.5cm, matching DB exactly. A separate egov.kz page gives detailed background/expression/glasses/headwear rules (gray background recommended, no blue, etc.) but that page is explicitly scoped to 'identity documents...to citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan' (i.e. national ID/passport for citizens) — since a visa is issued to foreign nationals under a different rule set (Annex 6), it was not applied here without an explicit visa-specific citation, per the truth-gate instruction.
